hook_text: One chair. Nine jobs. Miss just one, and the order fails.
clip_script: A school orders a hundred chairs from a small workshop. The owner plans the job: general management. Marketing agrees on the design and price. Purchasing buys the right pine at the right price. Human resources makes sure trained workers are ready. Production cuts, sands and checks every chair. Administration writes the order and the invoice. Financing keeps cash in the bank for wood and wages until the school pays. Risk management made sure the workshop was insured and safe. And when the chairs arrive, a photo of happy learners goes online: public relations. Nine functions, one chair. In a big company, nine departments. In a small one, one person wearing nine hats.
visual_style: A single wooden chair moving along a line while nine labelled hats drop onto it one by one; a final shot of one person juggling all nine hats.
pacing: Quick cuts for each function, a pause on the final line.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and match real business problems to the function that fixes them.
